ecological_question: Is rainfall-associated community turnover generated by broad, similar recruitment across species or by heterogeneous species-specific responses?
pairing: Reuse the exact eligible adjacent-year State × RouteNumber × RunNumber pairs and wetter/drier orientation from NAAMP_ECOLOGICAL_PULSE_CONTRACT_V0_1.

species_event.discordant_definition: For each pair and species present in exactly one member of the pair, score 1 if present only in the wetter run (wet gain) and 0 if present only in the drier run (dry loss).
species_event.concordant_species: Species present in both or neither run do not enter the gain/loss test.

eligibility.rule: Eligibility is based only on discordant comparison count and route coverage, not effect direction.

statistics.species_test: Two-sided exact binomial test of wet gains versus dry losses under p=0.5.
statistics.effect_summary: wet_gain_share and Haldane-corrected log odds log((wet_gains+0.5)/(dry_losses+0.5)).
statistics.heterogeneity_test: Chi-square test of the eligible species × {wet gain,dry loss} contingency table.
statistics.global_summary: Total wet gains, dry losses, and gain share across all species and eligible species.

interpretation.heterogeneous_positive_and_negative: Supports species-specific reproductive/activity responses to rainfall and a compositional filtering mechanism.
interpretation.mostly_positive_similar: Supports broad community recruitment after rain.
interpretation.no_heterogeneity: Community turnover may arise from stochastic temporal change rather than strongly differentiated species responses.

boundary: Species activity means acoustic calling presence across a standardized 10-stop run.
No abundance, occupancy, breeding-success, or causal rainfall claim.
This is a post-opening ecological extension frozen before species-specific readback.
